properties.bedrock_type: Lower Carboniferous sedimentary sandstone and mudstone (Gullane Formation) intersected by volcanic quartz-dolerite intrusions
properties.mineralogy: Fine to medium-grained quartzose sandstone, siltstone, and volcanic basaltic dolerite
properties.drainage: Steep hydrological runoff north-westward into the incised Water of Leith river basin

properties.primary_surfacing: Historic Whinstone setts, river valley revetment masonry, and tarmac access lanes
properties.wear_characteristics: Damp moss-fringed drainage channels, smoothed historic setts along Dean Path, aged river-bank retaining walls
properties.micro_grading: Steep natural gorge terrace dropping sharply from Rothesay Terrace down toward the Water of Leith

properties.groundcover: Riverbank turf, mossy embankment beds, and riparian scrub along the gorge flanks

properties.primary_building_typology: Scots Baronial and Vernacular 19th-century residential tenements and historic grain milling village complex (Dean Village)

structures.name: Well Court Tenement and Clock Tower Complex
structures.roof_geometry: Steeply pitched red clay pantiles and Scots slate with conical corbelled bartizans, crow-stepped gables, and a prominent clock tower
structures.facade_material: Pinkish and buff coursed Craigleith/Hailes sandstone ashlar and rubble
structures.weathering_patina: Pronounced historical coal-smoke carbon crusting in sheltered cornices, lintel soiling, and light lime efflorescence

structures.name: Damside / Mill Lower Vernacular Cottages
structures.roof_geometry: Pitched red pantile and grey slate dormered roofs
structures.facade_material: Harled masonry and exposed rubble sandstone with dressed quoins
structures.weathering_patina: Lichen growth on clay tiles, damp rising patina near river retaining wall base

structures.name: Hawthornbank Lane / Upper Valley Terraces
structures.roof_geometry: Multi-gabled grey Scottish slate roofs with heavy chimneystacks
structures.facade_material: Cream-buff ashlar sandstone and harled pale facades
structures.weathering_patina: Uniform urban soot wash, rain-washed water tables, and soot-blackened chimney pots

structures.name: Eastern Mansard Tenement Block
structures.roof_geometry: Steep grey slate mansard with timber-framed dormers and tall gable chimney gables
structures.facade_material: Stained buff sandstone ashlar with dressed margin architraves
structures.weathering_patina: Atmospheric coal-dust deposition across upper stone friezes and zinc/lead flashings

period_vehicles: Parked modern European compact passenger vehicles on paved court
street_furniture: Low rubble stone boundary walls with coping stones
Wrought iron railings along the river weir
pedestrian_profiles: Occasional morning commuters and walkers traversing the valley floor footpaths

properties.lighting_condition: Crisp Scottish early morning sunlight raking across the Dean gorge with warm low-angle golden highlights and cool blue skylight in deep architectural recesses
